q: How do I get a quote?
a: Call or text (435) 760-0806, or send the quote form. Tell us where the job is, how thick the concrete is, how many feet need to be cut or what size holes you need. The more detail you give, the faster we can price it. Quotes are free.
We are based in Logan, Utah and work across Cache Valley, Bear Lake, Southern Idaho, Brigham City, Ogden and Salt Lake City. We are willing to travel beyond those areas, so ask.

q: Can you come out on short notice?
a: Often, yes. Customers have told us we fit them in the same day they called. Call and we will tell you honestly what the schedule looks like.

q: Do you remove the concrete after cutting?
a: Yes. We can cut, break out, and haul away concrete. Let us know when you request a quote so we bring the right equipment.

q: Will cutting damage pipes or wires in the slab?
a: That is why we offer concrete scanning. Our scanner shows conduit, pipe, rebar, post-tension cables, wire mesh, in-floor heat lines and slab thickness before anyone cuts or drills.

q: Do you work with homeowners or only contractors?
a: Both. We cut egress windows, doorways and trenches for homeowners, and handle sawing, coring and demolition for general contractors, plumbers and electricians.
